full_page.content:
1951, January 22
Father Edward
Page 2
As for above-said "marker", I think we should be grateful indeed that the good God enabled us to procure such a creditable "memorial." Extremely brief of course, but even so, who knows how many a vocation its simple reading may be destined to awaken, to encourage, to anchor. Ah! "Its simple reading" ? - and the prayers and sighs there offered for vocations and, as we may surely hope, reinforced and reechced in Purgatory or and indeed even in Heaven - Fr. M. E. J. still active ...
Comparatively very few ever tried to fathom the meaning of those twenty years of humiliation to Fr. Maurice. And still fewer I think ever knew of the, at-least-dozen-yrs dispointment and humiliations where- by the merciful Divine Wisdom deigned to chisel and to emery him down to such calmly perfect acceptance of God's holy designs - as manifested both in the Mt. Hope San. and especially as you were privileged to see him, during rosary, slumber into Eternity; -- the "change", the transition -- "Tuis enim fidelious Domine Vita Mutatur non toliture." .... Oremus pro invicem ...
Fr. Solanus, ofm cap. L.J.C. et V.M.
